title: Log in with valid credentials
description: A visitor can sign in with valid credentials and start an authenticated session.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email or username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the authenticated session starts

title: Sign up with a new account
description: A visitor can create a new account and reach the registration success confirmation page.

steps.description: Navigate to /signup
Fill in the name field with a new display name
Fill in the username field with a unique username
Fill in the email field with a unique email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify a registration success confirmation is visible

title: Read a published article with author details
description: A visitor can open an article, read the full content, and view the author information while on the detail page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open a published article from the feed
Verify the full article content is displayed
Verify the author information is displayed

title: Open an article from the home feed
description: A visitor can open an article card from the home page and read the full article detail page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click an article card
Verify the full article detail page is displayed

title: Browse the home feed by category and search
description: A visitor can filter the home feed by category and keyword and see the article list update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a category filter
Fill in the search field with a keyword
Verify the article list updates to match the selected filters

title: Like an article from the detail page
description: A visitor can open an article detail page and like the post successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open a published article from the feed
Click the like control
Verify the post shows a liked state

title: Comment on an article while signed in
description: A logged-in user can open an article, submit a comment, and see it appear in the discussion.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Open a published article from the feed
Type a comment into the comment field
Submit the comment
Verify the new comment appears in the discussion

title: Prompt for login when commenting while signed out
description: A visitor who tries to comment on an article sees a prompt to log in before they can post.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open a published article from the feed
Type a comment into the comment field
Submit the comment
Verify a login prompt is displayed

title: Publish a new article
description: A logged-in user can create a new article and publish it successfully so the article is available as published.

steps.description: Navigate to /my-articles/new
Fill in the title field with Published article for testing
Fill in the description field with Published description for testing
Fill in the content field with a markdown article that includes the required heading format
Select a category
Set an image for the article
Publish the article
Verify the article is shown as published

title: Create and save a draft article
description: A logged-in user can create a new article and save it as a draft with the saved article remaining in draft state.

steps.description: Navigate to /my-articles/new
Fill in the title field with Draft article for testing
Fill in the description field with Draft description for testing
Fill in the content field with a markdown article that includes the required heading format
Select a category
Set an image for the article
Save the article as a draft
Verify the saved article is shown in draft state

title: Move through article pagination
description: A visitor can use pagination on the home feed to load additional published articles.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the pagination controls
Click the next page control
Verify a different set of articles is displayed

title: Update profile details successfully
description: A logged-in user can change their profile name, username, or avatar and see the updated profile information saved.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Navigate to /profile
Edit the name field
Edit the username field
Change the avatar
Save the profile changes
Verify the updated profile information is displayed

title: Update an existing article from the management list
description: A logged-in user can open one of their articles from the management list, edit it, and see the updated article reflected in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /my-articles
Open one of the user's existing articles for editing
Change the article title
Save the article changes
Verify the article list reflects the updated article

title: Change password successfully
description: A logged-in user can confirm their current password, enter a new password, and complete the password change.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Navigate to /reset-password
Fill in the current password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Fill in the new password field with a valid new password
Fill in the confirm new password field with the same valid new password
Save the password change
Verify a password update confirmation is displayed

title: Delete an article from the management list
description: A logged-in user can delete one of their articles after confirming the action and see it removed from the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /my-articles
Open one of the user's existing articles for editing
Delete the article
Confirm the deletion
Verify the article is removed from the list

title: Reject duplicate registration details
description: A visitor sees an error when trying to register with a username or email that is already taken.

steps.description: Navigate to /signup
Fill in the name field with a display name
Fill in the username field with an already used username
Fill in the email field with an already used email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify a duplicate account error is visible

title: Show validation when required article fields are missing
description: Submitting a new article with required information missing shows validation feedback and does not create the article.

steps.description: Navigate to /my-articles/new
Fill in the title field with Validation test article
Submit the article without completing all required fields
Verify validation errors are visible
Verify the article is not created

title: Reject invalid login credentials
description: A visitor sees an error when signing in with incorrect credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email or username field with an invalid username or email
Fill in the password field with an invalid password
Submit the login form
Verify an invalid credentials error is visible

title: Block publishing when article content lacks required headings
description: Publishing an article with invalid markdown structure shows validation feedback and prevents publication.

steps.description: Navigate to /my-articles/new
Fill in the title field with Heading validation article
Fill in the description field with Heading validation description
Fill in the content field with article content that does not include the required heading format
Select a category
Set an image for the article
Publish the article
Verify a publish validation error is visible
Verify the article is not published

title: View unread notification count
description: This verifies that an admin can open the notifications area and see their unread notification count reflected in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Click the link to the notifications area
Verify a notification unread count badge is displayed
Verify the notification feed is displayed

title: Create a new category in admin settings
description: An admin can create a category and see it appear in the category list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/categories
Open the new category form
Fill in the category name with Testing category
Save the category
Verify the new category appears in the list

title: Mark all notifications as read
description: This verifies that an admin can mark all notifications as read and see the unread count clear in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Click the link to the notifications area
Open the notification area
Click the control to mark all notifications as read
Verify the unread count badge is cleared
Verify the notification items are shown as read

title: Show a duplicate username error on profile save
description: A logged-in user who tries to save a username already in use sees a validation error and no profile update is completed.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Navigate to /profile
Edit the username field with a username that is already taken
Save the profile changes
Verify a duplicate username error is displayed

title: Edit an existing admin category
description: An admin can change an existing category name and see the updated category in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/categories
Open an existing category for editing
Change the category name
Save the category changes
Verify the updated category appears in the list

title: Show a password mismatch error
description: A logged-in user who enters mismatched new passwords on the password reset page sees a validation error and cannot complete the change.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Navigate to /reset-password
Fill in the current password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Fill in the new password field with one valid password
Fill in the confirm new password field with a different valid password
Save the password change
Verify a password mismatch error is displayed

title: Delete an unused admin category
description: An admin can delete a category after confirming the action and see it removed from the list when it is not in use.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/categories
Open an existing unused category for deletion
Delete the category
Confirm the deletion
Verify the category is removed from the list

title: Show an error when deleting a category that is in use
description: An admin sees an error when attempting to delete a category that is still assigned to posts, and the category remains available.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/categories
Open a category that is already used by posts for deletion
Delete the category
Confirm the deletion
Verify an error message is visible
Verify the category remains in the list
